normative_exit_criteria: a non-file in-memory invocation path reaches the computational boundary;
kernel-facing interfaces contain no path, file-unit or parser semantics;
legacy file runs still reproduce reference results through adapters;
output serialization does not mutate physical state;
non-midnight or non-day requests are not rejected merely because an adapter historically used daily files.

preserved_legacy_file_application_chain: crop rotation / crop development or assimilation
preserved_external_exchange_semantics: rain mm/d -> graidt/nraidt cm/d by factor 0.1
etref mm/d -> etr cm/d by factor 0.1
ptrans mm/d -> ptra cm/d by factor 0.1 when IPET=1
pevap mm/d -> peva cm/d by factor 0.1 when IPET=1
LAI, crop height and rooting depth are transferred explicitly through swap_input
criterion_3_reconciliation.finding: The missing C3 surface is not merely a file parser. The file-driven Hupsel route performs application-level meteorology, interception, crop, root-uptake, bottom-boundary and drainage composition before SoilWater. Current typed SWAP5 accepts the resulting prepared interval forcings but no admitted authority defines the complete field-level mapping from a preserved legacy file-driven case to those typed forcings.
criterion_3_reconciliation.why_not_implement_here: Filling the gap inside M1 closure would require selecting or reconstructing application-composition semantics process-by-process. That is a real production/scientific decision surface and must not be invented merely to obtain PASS.

dependency_reconciliation.relevant_change: Only bounded M1-C4 serializer/admission evidence was introduced for M1 purposes; no evidence was found that resolves or invalidates the C3 application-composition blocker.

next_permitted_action: Stop M1 closure work here. If criterion 3 is to be completed, open a separately governed bounded application-composition capability that recovers and fixes the process-by-process mapping from one preserved real legacy file-driven case to already-admitted typed SWAP5 state/forcing/config, then independently qualify reference equivalence through that adapter. Do not use F-ROSS12 as a substitute and do not broaden this into a stable public API or wholesale IO modernization project.
exclusions: production refactor merely to obtain PASS
